title: Trajectory Matching: Discrete Flow Matching with Structured Actions
abstract: arXiv:2610.32602v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The natural units of structured discrete generation are often not independent single-component edits but richer actions: attaching a fragment to a molecule, inserting a node together with an incident edge, or growing a hierarchy by adding a child. Yet most existing discrete flow matching methods (DFM) are restricted to independent component-wise edits over fixed-size states. This restriction stems from endpoint conditioning: endpoints fix the source and target during training but not the action sequence between them, making tractable conditional rates hard to define for complex actions that cannot be factorized component-wise. We propose trajectory matching, which conditions the flow on a full sequence of actions connecting the endpoints. This yields principled, simulation-free training targets for user-defined action spaces, including actions that change state size, modify multiple components, or depend on earlier actions. translated_title: 轨迹匹配：基于结构化动作的离散流匹配
translated_abstract: 结构化离散生成的自然单元通常不是独立的单组件编辑，而是更丰富的动作：例如将一个片段连接到分子上、将一个节点及其关联边一起插入、或通过添加子节点来扩展层次结构。然而，大多数现有的离散流匹配方法（DFM）仅限于对固定大小状态进行独立的逐组件编辑。这一限制源于端点条件化：端点在训练期间固定了源和目标，却未固定两者之间的动作序列，导致对于无法按组件分解的复杂动作，难以定义可处理的条件速率。我们提出了轨迹匹配，它将流条件化于连接端点的完整动作序列之上。这为用户自定义的动作空间提供了有原则的、无需模拟的训练目标，其中包括改变状态大小、同时修改多个组件或依赖于先前动作的动作。我们证明……
tldr: 提出轨迹匹配方法，将离散流匹配条件化于连接端点的完整动作序列，从而支持改变状态大小、修改多个组件及依赖历史的结构化动作，为用户自定义动作空间提供有原则的、无需模拟的训练目标。
en_tdlr: Proposes trajectory matching, which conditions discrete flow matching on the full action sequence connecting endpoints, enabling user-defined structured actions (such as changing state size, modifying multiple components, or depending on earlier actions) with principled, simulation-free training targets.
